title: Product Comparison with AI
description: Use AI to research, compare, and recommend between two products — and learn the limits of what AI knows.
steps: Choose two real products you are considering buying (or have recently compared)
Use Perplexity to get a sourced overview of each product
Use Claude to write a structured comparison: "Compare [A] vs [B] for someone who [your use case]. Format as a table with pros/cons per category."
Identify 2-3 specific claims that need checking — verify them via the manufacturer site or a review site
Ask: "What questions should I ask a salesperson that AI cannot answer?"
expectedOutput: A verified product comparison document plus a list of questions that require human expertise.
bonusChallenges: Compare the AI recommendation against a human expert review
Ask AI to steelman the product it did NOT recommend
